description:
§42.2.3 — the soft-deprecated in-place presence guard inside a markup `${ … }`, over a reactive `T | not` cell (`${ given @user :> {

${@user.name}

} }`), surfaces W-GIVEN-PRESENCE-DEPRECATED (Info; exactly 1), is accepted (inside the guard `@user` is narrowed, so the member read is not E-TYPE-046), renders while `@user` is present, and re-renders when the present value changes (click #go: "ada" → "bob"). Since #1380 (S461) impl#1 reads the cell and renders the markup body. NOTE: the canonical rewrite `${ if (@user is given) { … } }` keeps the stale "ada" on impl#1 today (g-impl1-markup-if-branch-memo-stale-render-s462), so `scrml fix` refuses this site; no canonical twin is pinned here.
rationale: §42.2.3 (S462) — the in-place guard in markup context is SOFT-DEPRECATED and surfaces W-GIVEN-PRESENCE-DEPRECATED; §42.3.5 item 2 — the guard narrows its receiver; §42.5 — the guard's body runs when the name is present; §6 — a markup interpolation of a cell re-renders on change. Provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S462 "a, go".
